name: r4a await readdir then sort on any array
source: import fs from "node:fs"; async function listed(): Promise<void> { console.log((await fs.promises.readdir("/")).sort().length > 0); } function main(): void { const x = Array.from([1, 2], (v: any) => v); const y = new Array(3).fill(0); console.log(x.join(","), y.join(",")); listed(); }
